metadata.source: Public bug bounty methodology, our synthesis
metadata.provenance: Synthesized from public methodology, no private data

methodologies.affected_component: search, comment, profile, any input reflected
methodologies.prerequisite: Input reflected or stored without encoding
methodologies.discovery_methodology: Recon: identify inputs that are reflected or stored. Check for WAF. Test with witness payload or . Check context: HTML, attribute, JS, URL.
methodologies.evidence_pattern: Request with payload, response with payload unescaped or executed, screenshot, tool output (curl, browser)
methodologies.validation_method: Reproduce with minimal payload, check if script executes, try bypasses for WAF, confirm not false positive (comment, encoded, CSP)
methodologies.impact: Account takeover, session hijacking, defacement, depending on context
methodologies.remediation: Output encoding, CSP, validate input, frameworks auto-escape
methodologies.report_structure: Endpoint, param, payload, observed evidence, repro steps, impact, remediation, references (CWE-79, OWASP A03)

methodologies.prerequisite: Endpoint uses ID, auth required, but no ownership check
methodologies.discovery_methodology: Recon: identify API endpoints with IDs, check if IDs sequential/predictable, check auth. Test: auth as user A, try to access user B's object by changing ID. Minimal proof, not full PII extraction.
methodologies.evidence_pattern: Request as user A to /api/users/124 (other user) returns 200 with other user data (redact PII to last 6 chars in chat, full to evidence file), tool output (curl)
methodologies.validation_method: Reproduce with two test accounts, confirm user A can access user B's data, check if authz missing, try without auth (should be 401), try different ID formats
methodologies.impact: Access to other users' PII, financial data, depending on endpoint
methodologies.remediation: Authorization check for every request, random UUIDs, deny by default
methodologies.report_structure: Endpoint, method, IDs (user A and B), observed evidence (200 with other user data), repro steps, impact, remediation, references (CWE-862, OWASP API1)

methodologies.affected_component: Any input that goes to SQL: URL params (id), form fields (login, search)
methodologies.prerequisite: Input included in SQL query without sanitization
methodologies.discovery_methodology: Recon: identify inputs that might go to DB. Test: single quote ' for error, boolean ' AND 1=1 -- vs ' AND 1=2 -- for difference, time ' AND SLEEP(2) -- for delay (minimal 2 sec), union ' UNION SELECT 1,2,3 -- for reflection. Never destructive without approval.
methodologies.evidence_pattern: Request with payload causes SQL error or time delay or data, tool output (curl, sqlmap --risk 1 minimal)
methodologies.validation_method: Reproduce with minimal proof, check if error genuine SQL error, try bypasses, confirm not false positive (generic error, WAF)
false_positive_indicators: Input validation rejecting quote but not SQLi
methodologies.impact: Data extraction, auth bypass, RCE depending on DB and query
methodologies.remediation: Parameterized queries, ORM, input validation, least privilege DB user
methodologies.report_structure: Endpoint, param, payload, observed (error/delay/data), repro steps, impact, remediation, references (CWE-89, OWASP A03)

methodologies.affected_component: Inputs that fetch URLs: image URL, webhook URL, file import, etc.
methodologies.prerequisite: App fetches remote resource without validating user-supplied URL
methodologies.discovery_methodology: Recon: identify inputs that fetch URLs. Test: http://127.0.0.1, http://localhost, http://[::1], http://0.0.0.0 for internal. For cloud metadata http://169.254.169.254 requires approval high-impact. Use collaborator for out-of-band with approval.
methodologies.evidence_pattern: Request to internal URL returns internal data or time delay, tool output
methodologies.validation_method: Reproduce with internal URL, check if internal data returned, bypass via 0.0.0.0, 127.1, etc.
methodologies.impact: Access to internal services, cloud metadata (critical), RCE depending on service
methodologies.remediation: Validate URLs, allow list, deny list for private IPs, disable unnecessary schemas
methodologies.report_structure: Endpoint, param, payload (internal URL), observed (internal data), repro steps, impact, remediation, references (CWE-918, OWASP A10)
